text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During that day's lunch break,
a game of dodgeball was taking place in the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beeeeeep!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, am I all alone now!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Damn it! I can't hit it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~!
Alright, now it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Tohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! ...Hehe, caught it!
Alright then, here goes—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaahhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! Are you alright!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible pitch!
Top Road-chan, you're so strong~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you very much! You were the one who was super good at dodging, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Ehehe~!
You know, dodging is my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump... thump...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ? Is someone in the gym...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heeei-yah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, Top Road-chan! Yahoo--!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan... Are you practicing
for dodgeball, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanted to try throwing
the ball with a big WHAM too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I could throw like Top Road-chan, it looks like it'd be so fun! And then maybe I could win next time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Top Road-chan!
Could you teach me how to throw?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If you're fine with me...
I'd be more than happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With dismissal time approaching, I heard voices coming from the gym
and went over to check who was there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Let's try putting a bit more power into it when stepping in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aargh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Looking good! That's a huge improvement!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Top Road-chan is teaching me
how to throw a dodgeball!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...No. In fact, I'm the one
who's learning from you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn from Urara-chan's
undying determination to improve too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Usually, getting right back up
after losing is really hard, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Like wondering why I lost, or thinking I should have done this or that instead...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Cowering under self-loathing and regret, I can't even begin to think about what comes next...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still, instead of having regrets, Urara-chan moves forward, happily talking about what lies ahead...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I respect her so much.
That's why I've been learning so many things from her!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Top Road-chan!
Let's hurry and do the next practice!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, excuse me.
Well then, I'll get back to practice!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, looking at it from that perspective,
there seems to be a lot to learn from Haru Urara.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your power-up!
I'm looking forward to seeing you power up!
Go get some guts in you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, looking at it from that perspective,
there seems to be a lot to learn from Haru Urara.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your power-up!
I'm looking forward to seeing you power up!
Go get some guts in you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Leave it to me!
I will certainly live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to resume practice!
Here I go, Urara-chan! Haaap!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're going a bit too fast~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I accidentally put too much force into it...
I'm so soooorryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now then, Urara-chan.
Please guide me and show me the ropes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gobentatsu...?
Ah, did you mean obento (lunch box)?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure! Next time, let's bring our lunchboxes and eat together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Absolutely!
Let's eat together!
